data.name: Project Octavia
data.detailed_description:
In the immersive Stealth Action multiplayer game Project Octavia, take on the role of a super spy infiltrating for intel on a high-threat technology of extraterrestrial origin.

Stylized third-person action meets infiltration, gunplay, hand-to-hand Close Quarter Combat (CQC) and innovative gadget crafting with brand new science-fiction based stealth action multiplayer gameplay!

Infiltrate and Acquire: Searching and assessing will give players options and strategies to plan out and implement on the road to finding and holding critical intel objectives.

Tactics and Teamwork: Teams are more powerful together as players can utilize tactical-lite gameplay to cement a victory or make a last minute comeback to take the match.

Dynamic Player Choices: Players can utilize the immersive and dynamic sandbox world and play their spy the way that fits their style. Use weapons or don’t, all options are fun and embraced by the game and all can lead to a win!

Innovative Multiplayer Stealth: New and innovative stealth gameplay allows for players to still have that important “reset loop” to hide and avoid detection and defeat even in multiplayer.

A New Universe: A stylized noir alternate-history Cold War setting where espionage and intrigue are the foundation.

Spy Action: Sneak, shoot, kick or trap your way to the end game of a 20-minute match where action can shift at any moment and will always surprise.

Variety of Modes: 2 to 5 teams of trios, duos or solos (solos up to 8 players) and a unique “social solos” mode all give players different ways to enjoy the game where the stakes can be high or casual or even psychological hide and seek mayhem. More PvP(vE) and PvE co-op modes are in the works and will be added down the road.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4440 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti [4 GB] or Radeon RX 570 [4 GB] or Intel Arc A380 [6 GB]
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 2070 [8 GB] or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT [8 GB] or Intel Arc A580 [8 GB]
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
